title: Air Cargo News - 07 October 2026
description: Today's air cargo news: Airfreight rates edge up in September ahead of peak season; Flexport launches AI agent booking tools for freight; Challenge Group suspends freighter flights to Navi Mumbai Airport. Global air cargo developments reflect shifting digital booking capabilities, rate adjustments, and evolving network footprints.
transcript: Good morning MAC Fellas, this is MAC FM, your unofficial air-cargo morning radio. Starting with September data, global airfreight rates edged upward as carriers prep for peak season. Yield and revenue trends could definitely shift with that demand. On the tech side, Flexport launched an MCP server letting shippers' AI agents book freight and pull quotes. That kind of automation might redefine digital interaction standards across forwarding. And finally, Challenge Group suspended its freighter operations serving Navi Mumbai Airport. Highlighting potential infrastructure or handling challenges at newly launched facilities.

title: Air Cargo News - 06 October 2026
description: Today's air cargo news: Europe-Brazil Pharma Transport Surges; Peak Season Pressure Forecast to Vary; Ethiopian Airlines Expands Freighter Fleet. Global air and specialized cargo markets are experiencing localized growth spikes and uneven capacity pressures, demanding flexible network planning.
transcript: Good morning, MAC Fellas, this is unofficial air-cargo radio. Let's dive right in. Starting with pharma: transport between Europe and Brazil grew 150 percent in 2026. That points to higher demand for specialized temperature-controlled capacity on that lane. Elsewhere, peak season pressure is expected to develop unevenly across origins and cargo types. Meaning we could see a need for flexible capacity utilization and dynamic allocation. And finally, Ethiopian Airlines ordered eight Boeing 777-8Fs and two 777Fs for its cargo unit. Showing steady confidence in dedicated widebody freighter capacity expansion in Africa.
